about.title: About JobVeylo
about.intro: Clear job details. Original sources. A more informed next step.
sections: What we do

JobVeylo is an independent job-information website covering Indian government recruitment and private-sector roles worldwide. We summarise recruitment notices and link to the original application destination. We are not an employer, recruitment agency or government service.
What you can expect

Job pages explain the stated location, experience, qualifications, salary and deadline. If a source does not provide a detail, we label it as not specified or not disclosed. Remote jobs may still have country or work-authorisation restrictions.
Free to browse

JobVeylo does not charge readers to view listings or application links, collect applications, promise interviews, or guarantee placements. Applications are handled by the linked recruiting organisation.
How we work

Listings may be published automatically after checks against an approved employer feed, or prepared manually by the owner. Read our editorial policy for the limits of automatic extraction, corrections and expired openings.

editorial.title: Editorial policy
editorial.intro: How we select, check, update and correct job information.
sections: Source selection

We prioritise employer career pages and official government recruitment notifications. A third-party job board may help us discover a role, but the source type and application destination must be clearly identified. A listing should never imply employer or government endorsement of JobVeylo.
Before publication

Automatic publication checks that an opening remains in an approved employer feed, suppresses duplicate links and excludes records with known conflicts, expired dates or missing original notices. Freshers and roles accepting up to three years are prioritised. Automatic pages are brief factual summaries; they do not claim a human checked every requirement. Manual listings may receive additional editorial review. We do not invent salaries, vacancy counts, selection rounds or graduation batches.
What “source checked” means

The date records an automated or manual source check. It is not an independent guarantee of hiring, safety, accuracy or continuing availability. Automatic extraction can miss details or misclassify experience. Applicants should read the complete latest original notice before applying.
Updates and closed jobs

When a listing has a recorded closing date, JobVeylo marks it closed after that date using India time. The source’s exact deadline and time zone take priority. Listings without deadlines need manual review. Closed pages remain useful for reference, with their application buttons removed.
Corrections

Email us with the JobVeylo page URL, the detail that needs correction and an original source or amended notice. We review reports and update, close or remove listings as appropriate. We do not promise a fixed response time.
Advertising and sponsorships

No ad network or paid placement programme is currently active. If introduced, advertising, sponsorships and affiliate relationships will be clearly disclosed. Payment will not replace source review or imply a hiring guarantee.

privacy.title: Privacy & browser storage
privacy.intro: What this version of JobVeylo stores and why.
sections: Reading and saving jobs

Saved-job identifiers are stored in your browser under jv-saved. Older versions may have drafts under jv-drafts. Job applications are submitted on employer websites. Resume-builder content stays in page memory until you clear it, reload or leave; we do not save it to local storage.
Resume builder and AI processing

Uploaded PDF, Word and text files are read on your device. Readable name and contact details, including embedded PDF links and Word hyperlinks, are used to fill editable download fields locally. Extraction can miss or misidentify details, so review them before applying. If you choose AI tailoring and consent, extracted or typed resume text and the selected job details are sent through our server to Groq. Contact fields are added locally to downloads; automated removal from source text may miss personal information. Review your text before sending. We do not save resume content or AI drafts in our database or intentionally log them. We store daily usage counters with a keyed connection identifier to enforce free limits; counters expire after the day and are removed during later requests. Hosting providers may retain technical connection logs. Groq processes submitted content under its own privacy and data policies and may retain limited information for security or troubleshooting. We do not promise zero provider retention. Clear resume data removes the current form and draft; it cannot recall information already sent to a provider. AI drafts can contain mistakes and must be reviewed before use.
WhatsApp job subscriptions

When subscriptions open, you can choose a job category and send the displayed consent message from your own WhatsApp account. We store your phone number, chosen category, daily frequency, consent time and subscription status in Cloudflare D1. Reply STOP to unsubscribe. We retain a stopped subscription record to prevent further alerts and to respect your choice; a later explicit consent message can restart it. Message identifiers used to prevent duplicate processing are retained for up to 30 days and removed during later webhook requests. WhatsApp and Meta process messages under their own policies. Resume information and your contact list are not used to enrol subscribers. Subscription signup and outbound delivery remain disabled while setup is incomplete.
Owner dashboard

GitHub verifies the authorised owner account. JobVeylo requests public identity access only, not repository access. An HttpOnly, Secure session cookie keeps the owner signed in for up to eight hours. Hashed session identifiers and their expiry are stored in Cloudflare D1; signing out revokes the session. Editorial drafts, published listings and their status are stored in D1. Drafts are restricted to the owner dashboard; published listings are public.
Hosting, sign-in and fonts

Cloudflare hosts the website and database, and GitHub provides owner sign-in. These providers may process connection information, authentication cookies and technical logs to operate and secure the site. Provider retention and processing are governed by their own policies.
Email enquiries

If you email us, your address, message and any attachments are processed by our email provider and used to respond to or resolve the enquiry. Please do not send passwords, identity documents, banking information or CVs. We have not configured an automatic deletion schedule for correspondence.
Sharing and external links

Copy link uses your browser clipboard after you click the button. Share opening uses your device’s sharing interface when supported. Content is sent to another app only when you choose to share it. Employer websites and social platforms have their own privacy policies.
Analytics and advertising
JobVeylo has no active advertising network. Public-page usage is counted automatically using aggregate counters described below. The Google Analytics script is no longer loaded.
Your choices

You can clear local saved jobs and older drafts below or through your browser settings. Clearing local storage does not remove listings stored in the owner dashboard. Contact us with privacy questions or requests about information you have sent us.
Aggregate visitor analytics

JobVeylo automatically counts public page views, fixed traffic-source and campaign labels, Apply clicks and resume-tool clicks in daily aggregates stored in Cloudflare D1. This analytics system does not use cookies, browser storage, visitor identifiers or fingerprinting, and does not store IP addresses, full referrer URLs, query strings, resume content or contact fields. It does not count unique people. Admin and authentication pages are excluded. Browsers, blocking tools and automated traffic can affect counts. Counts are visible only to the owner. Hosting providers still process connection information to deliver and secure the website. Earlier Google Analytics data remains subject to Google privacy policies; new visits are not sent to Google Analytics.

disclaimer.title: Job information disclaimer
disclaimer.intro: Use JobVeylo to discover opportunities, then check the original notice.
sections: Independent information
JobVeylo is not affiliated with the employers or government bodies listed unless a relationship is explicitly disclosed. Employer names identify recruitment sources; they do not imply endorsement.
No hiring guarantee

Listings and career guides are informational. Availability, eligibility, selection processes and application requirements may change. We cannot guarantee an interview, offer, placement, salary or successful application. The recruiting organisation’s current notice takes priority.
Fees and sensitive information

JobVeylo does not request payment to apply for a job. Some official recruitment processes may specify an application fee; verify it in the original notice and use the official payment process. Do not share passwords or OTPs, or send payments to someone claiming to guarantee selection through JobVeylo.
Applications and disputes

Applications take place on external websites. Direct application-status questions to the recruiting organisation. Report inaccurate or suspicious JobVeylo listings through our contact page, including the page URL and evidence.
